title: You Lack One Thing: EP 65 - Dinner Is Ready - fra Ante Vučković and Stanko Stojić

reels.title: “Is it I?” – the question Mark asks every reader
reels.hook: Why did no one ask: who is the traitor?
reels.why: An unexpected twist: the disciples do not ask who the traitor is, but “Is it I?”. From a biblical detail arises a personal question for everyone, with a clear point at the end.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković
reels.quote: That it is not most important to know who it is, but that it is most important to know where I stand in relation to the teacher, lest I perhaps betray him.

cards.text: Why did no one ask: who is the traitor?

reels.title: Heel on the head: why betrayal at the table is the worst betrayal
reels.hook: What does it mean to lift a heel against someone's head?
reels.why: A powerful, vivid gesture of victorious kings opens an ancient psalm and leads to a universal insight about betrayal from up close.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković
reels.quote: In other words, that is the greatest possible betrayal, that we share the same table, the same food.

reels.title: Judas repented – but was left alone with his condemnation
reels.hook: Judas repented. Why was that not enough?
reels.why: An emotional and surprising look at Judas: the hardest state is self-condemnation without meeting the teacher's gaze, unlike Peter. It strikes everyone who has condemned themselves.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković
reels.quote: That is perhaps the hardest state into which a person can fall, into a state of self-condemnation

reels.title: “It grows in the store” – how we lost contact with life
reels.hook: Where do tomatoes come from? “They grow in the store.”
reels.why: A humorous and recognizable picture of modern man who has never seen how cabbage grows, along with a surprising insight about pets as a substitute for contact with the living world.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković
reels.quote: A good portion of people have never seen how a tomato grows, how cabbage grows, where an apple grows

reels.title: Did Jesus announce the Age of Aquarius? Fra Ante answers
reels.hook: Did Jesus announce the Age of Aquarius?
reels.why: A controversial thesis known from movies and the song “Age of Aquarius” receives a clear and well-argued answer. The viewer immediately knows what it is about.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković
reels.quote: That is a very arbitrary interpretation, because there is nothing, absolutely nothing inside, except symbolism that someone interprets in their own way.

reels.title: Slaughtering a lamb – brutal? Every steak on a plate has the same story
reels.hook: Meat on a plate has a story we hide
reels.why: A provocative contrast: slaughtering the Passover lamb seems brutal, yet the same happens with every meat we eat, only we have learned to hide it.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković
reels.quote: But that is the only way we get meat on the table.

reels.title: Do not wait for a better time for those you love
reels.hook: Do not wait for a better time for those you love
reels.why: Brief, universal, and practical advice on close relationships, drawn from the image of the Last Supper. Easily shareable.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković

reels.title: The man with a pitcher of water: an agreed sign or prophetic knowledge?
reels.hook: Did Jesus arrange a “sign” in advance?
reels.why: A skeptical question from the host immediately creates tension, and the answer opens a larger topic: Jesus consciously knows what awaits him.
reels.speaker: fra Ante Vučković
reels.quote: That would be a setup that is not at all appropriate to everything we have learned about Him so far.
